name: My Last Heatwave
source:
Someone is stuck in their apartment during a heatwave.
At least they have Halley-J.

[From [url=https://nothack-europa.itch.io/my-last-heatwave]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
熱浪來襲，有個人困在公寓裡出不去。
好在還有哈莉-J相伴。
